title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.18 — Clarified LLM candidates count & translation cleanups
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.18 — 明确场景 LLM 最大结果数与翻译路径净化

text.en_US:
1) Clarified LLM Candidate Count: The candidate count setting in the scene dialog is now clearly labeled as 'LLM Max Results' with an informative tooltip, preventing confusion with the final candidate menu count.

2) Cleaned Translation Metadata: Standardized all location paths in the Qt translation catalog to clean repository-relative paths.
text.zh_CN:
1）明确场景 LLM 最大结果数：后处理场景配置中的“候选数量”正式更名为“LLM 最大结果数”，并新增详细悬停提示，彻底解除与输入法候选词浮窗总条数的歧义。

2）净化翻译元数据路径：将 Qt 翻译文件中的本地开发路径全面重构为标准相对路径，保证开源仓库规范与整洁。
